_doc: Game UI copy and timing (client only; src/client/ui.ts). praise lines are picked by combo size (points at or above each tier's min), bail lines on a slam, taglines rotate under the menu, tips show while loading and on pause, results lines get {score}, {pct} (share of a SoMa studio's monthly rent) and {burritos} ("7 Mission burritos"). rent and burrito are the dollar prices the jokes use. stickers: big combos slap sick.png, slams slap slam.png. signatures: each character's own names for the special tricks (by trick id), shown in the trick string with a glow. hints: first-time tips shown once each (remembered in the browser) when their moment comes. carHit / robotaxiHit / pedHit: callouts when a car or a robotaxi knocks you down, or you run into a pedestrian. credits: the Credits screen. places: the banner when you roll into a landmark (spots: centre and radius in site metres, or a box [minX, minY, maxX, maxY], checked first) or a neighbourhood (hoods: the nearest centre wins; a neighbourhood can have several centres); positions are the OpenStreetMap place nodes (or a point inside the place's outline where OSM maps it as an area: Alamo Square, the Lower Haight) and park outlines projected into the site frame (sf world only). You must stay holdSeconds before it shows, each place waits cooldownSeconds before it shows again, and it stays up showSeconds.

tips: Hold K, let go to ollie. Longer hold, higher pop.
Press I near a ledge or rail to lock into a grind.
W then S lands you in a manual. Keep the combo alive.
Collect S-K-A-T-E in a run for bragging rights.

Tuck to go faster downhill. Bring knees.

In the character picker, left and right change the outfit.
Twin Peaks bomb: 1.6 km down Upper Market. Tuck the straights, scrub before the 19th curve.
Finish a Hill Bomb and your best run comes back as a ghost to race.
Fog City Punk plays without the internet. ] to tune in.
Game of S.K.A.T.E.: a sketchy landing counts as a miss. Land it clean.

hints.text: Hold <kbd>K</kbd> to crouch, let go to ollie
In the air: <kbd>J</kbd> + arrow for a flip, <kbd>L</kbd> + arrow for a grab
Near a ledge or rail, press <kbd>I</kbd> to grind
<kbd>W</kbd> then <kbd>S</kbd> to manual and keep the combo going
<kbd>E</kbd> steps off the board. Walk anywhere, <kbd>E</kbd> again to ride
<kbd>]</kbd> radio, <kbd>V</kbd> saves the last 15 s as a video
Right behind a car? Hold <kbd>L</kbd> to skitch, <kbd>A</kbd><kbd>D</kbd> to balance
Over back-to-back ramps, <kbd>;</kbd> in the air spine-transfers
<kbd>Esc</kbd> then Missions, Goals: things to do round San Francisco
<kbd>M</kbd> the city map, <kbd>F</kbd> talks to anyone with a mark over them

credits.title: The park
lines: SoMa West Skatepark, San Francisco (New Line Skateparks design, SF Public Works). Rebuilt for the game from public plans and surveys, NOAA and USGS LiDAR, and 26 photos of the park taken for the project, which also paint it.

credits.title: The city
lines: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (openstreetmap.org/copyright)
DataSF (City and County of San Francisco), PDDL 1.0: right of way, curbs, curb ramps, building footprints, street trees, streets, Rec and Park assets
Elevation: U.S. Geological Survey, 3D Elevation Program (public domain)
Pier 7 measured on NOAA National Geodetic Survey 2022 orthoimagery of San Francisco (public domain)

credits.title: Art and sound
lines: Sounds and props: Kenney Impact Sounds, City Kit (Roads), Furniture Kit, Mini Market and Retro Urban Kit (CC0)
Street cars: Free Low Poly Vehicles Pack by Raphael Gonçalves, Rgsdev (CC0)
AI-generated voices (OpenAI text to speech): the robotaxi, Muni, the radio DJs and the story's characters. Synthetic, not recordings of people.
AI-generated images (OpenAI): the murals, the logo and the burrito
Characters, boards, signs, portraits, menu photographs and the radio's music: made in code for the game
Type: Inter, Archivo and IBM Plex Mono (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

credits.title: Radio
lines: SoMa Skate FM, Fog City Punk and KSOMA Hyphy Hour: lo-fi beats, skate punk and Bay Area beats generated live in your browser. Every station is fictional.

credits.title: Made with
lines: Made by the SoMa Skate contributors. Code under GPL-3.0, original art and data under CC BY-SA 4.0; third-party assets keep their own licences (CREDITS.md).

spots.line: Postcard Row. Somebody is taking your picture.

spots.name: Alamo Square

spots.name: Patricia's Green
spots.line: Benches with a reputation. Be nice to the art.

spots.name: 24th St Mission BART
spots.line: The plaza by the station: pigeons, pan dulce, a train every few minutes.

spots.name: UN Plaza
spots.line: Granite ledges for days. The pigeons were here first.

spots.name: San Francisco City Hall
spots.line: The steps everyone wants. Wedding parties have right of way.

spots.name: Civic Center Plaza
spots.line: Lawns, ledges and a dome that photobombs every clip.

spots.name: Ferry Building
spots.line: The clock tower at the foot of Market. Everybody's meeting someone here.

spots.name: Embarcadero Plaza (EMB)
spots.line: EMB. Half the ledges in skate history are here. Security knows.

spots.name: Pier 7
spots.line: Long granite, long benches, and the bay right there if you overshoot.

spots.name: Pier 39
spots.line: The sea lions moved onto the K-dock in 1990 and never left. They have seniority.

spots.name: Fisherman's Wharf
spots.line: Chowder in a bread bowl, and a gull who wants it more than you.

spots.name: Powell & Market
spots.line: The cable car turns around by hand here. The line moves slower.

spots.name: Lombard Street
spots.line: Eight hairpins of brick, hydrangeas, and a queue of rental cars.

spots.name: Hyde Street
spots.line: The top of the cable car hill. Mind the slot.

spots.name: Washington Square
spots.line: Tai chi at dawn, focaccia by noon, church bells all day.

spots.name: Dragon Gate
spots.line: The gate into Chinatown. Grant Avenue goes uphill from here.

spots.name: Grant Avenue
spots.line: Lanterns overhead and the oldest street in town underfoot.

spots.name: Columbus Avenue
spots.line: Espresso, gelato, and a street that cuts every block corner to corner.

spots.name: Fog City Skate Shop
spots.line: Big Lou's shop. Decks on the walls, a mini ramp in the back.

spots.name: Taqueria La Niebla
spots.line: The fog comes in, the burritos go out.

spots.name: Suds City Laundromat
spots.line: Spin cycle. Not that kind.

spots.name: Valencia Corner Market
spots.line: Open late. Snacks, sodas, wax for your board.

spots.name: City Hall Lobby
spots.line: Gloria's permit window. Take a number.

spots.name: Potrero del Sol
spots.line: The city's biggest skatepark: bowls all the way down.

spots.name: Lilac Street
spots.line: More murals. Look, don't grind the paint.

spots.name: Freeway DIY
spots.line: Concrete poured by skaters at night. Respect it.

spots.name: Duboce Rooftop
spots.line: A low roof. Pallets, a dumpster, a stair. Your call.

spots.name: 24th St Lowriders
spots.line: Three lowriders, parked low. Hop them. Don't scratch the paint.
